policy.privacy.body:
We use your details only to process orders, deliver items and keep your account secure.
Payment card details are handled by Razorpay and are never stored by BASKET.
policy.privacy.title: Privacy
policy.returns.body:
Eligible items can be returned within the return window shown on the product page.
Start a return from My orders. Refunds go back to the original payment method after the store confirms the item was received.
policy.returns.title: Returns & refunds
policy.shipping.body:
Each store ships its own items. Orders with items from several stores may arrive in separate shipments.
Tracking updates appear in My orders as each store packs and ships.
policy.shipping.title: Shipping & delivery
policy.terms.body:
Prices, stock and offers are set by each store and may change.
BASKET verifies stores before they can sell, but each store remains responsible for the items it sells.
policy.terms.title: Terms of use
